status.label: Needs reproduction details
status.detail: Fork mirror issue 237 converged on a modifier-swap state race, but the clean two-row repro and environment details are still missing.

comment.body: Could you provide the Windows build, elevation state, a clean two-row repro recording or trace, and whether another remapper is installed? Please include which key combinations fail.

design.root_cause: Modifier-only remaps are not atomic: the physical source modifier remains visible while the replacement modifier is injected, creating transient or stale Alt+Win state.
design.fix_plan: Add an atomic modifier-swap path with explicit per-source state, paired transitions, injection-failure handling, and engine regression tests.
repro: Configure Left Alt to Left Win and Left Win to Left Alt
Exercise Start, Alt+Tab, Alt+F4, Win+R/E/M, and repeated keyups
verify: Injection failure leaves no stale modifier state
